apis.name: get_student_query_pages
apis.description: Fetch student query page listing from the student query module.
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks about student queries, query queue, or query pages (not dossiers or payments).

apis.name: get_student_data_pages
apis.description: Fetch student data page listing (core student profile / data grids).
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks for student data listings, student records table, or profile data pages.

apis.name: get_student_dossier_pages
apis.description: Fetch student dossier listing pages (case files / dossier bundles).
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks for student dossiers, dossier lists, or dossiers created or updated on a date (e.g. today). Pass createdFrom/createdTo as YYYY-MM-DD when they mention a day or range.

createdFrom.description: Inclusive start date filter on created date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

createdTo.description: Inclusive end date filter on created date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). For 'today', set both createdFrom and createdTo to today's date.

apis.name: get_student_payment_pages
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks about payments, fees, invoices, or billing pages for students. Use the available query parameters to filter by name, phone, email, date ranges (start_date/end_date), status, state, city, university, or fee waiver category. Format the results as a Markdown table.

ordering.description: Ordering of results (e.g., '-id' for descending ID)

apis.name: get_student_campus_pages
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks about student campus assignments or campus-related student pages.

apis.name: get_faculty_campus_pages
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks about faculty on campus or faculty campus listings.

apis.name: get_career_applications
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks about career applications, applicants, or job application lists.

apis.name: get_career_partners
apis.purpose: Use when the user asks about career partners or employer partners.

apis.name: test_students
apis.purpose: Use only for connectivity checks or when explicitly asked to hit the test students endpoint.

apis.name: test_students_excel
apis.purpose: Use when the user explicitly wants the test Excel export endpoint.
